# Kluzar Outreach

Kluzar Outreach is a workspace for managing email outreach campaigns, lead lists, conditional follow-up sequences, sender accounts, and replies.

The service is designed for customers to connect a mailbox they control. Kluzar does not provide customer mailboxes. A Kluzar sender is available for fallback and test messages.

The product includes CSV lead imports, workspace-scoped records, unsubscribe and bounce suppression, stop-on-reply sequences, campaign event tracking, and test mode that sends only to the user's own address.

The offer is free for a limited time. This build has no checkout and no paid plans.
